products.product_description: Kirkland Signature brand Real Sliced Fruit, Item # 527069. The UPC on the master cardboard case is 0 96619 52706 9. Each cardboard case consists of 20 plastic pouches (7.41 oz): 10 pouches of Fuji Apple Slices, 5 pouches of Strawberry Banana Slices, and 5 pouches of Fuji Apple Slices with Cinnamon. The UPC on Fuji Apple Slices pouch is 0 96619 27072 9; The UPC Strawberry Banana Slices pouch is 0 96619 27070 5; The UPC Fuji Apple Slices with Cinnamon pouch is 0 96619 27071 2; Product is distributed by: Costco Wholesale Corp., P.O.Box 34535, Seattle, WA 98124-1535, 1-800-774-2678, www.costco.com
products.code_info: Best Before: FEB142015 to MAR112015. It interprets as February 14, 2015 to March 11, 2015;
